run_mapcc_pipeline: run the MAP-CC dataset download and extraction pipeline via Slurm with CollectMapccStep, ExtractMapccStep, and JsonlWriter
extract_mapcc_data: extract MAP-CC Chinese monolingual data from concatenated gzip files and yield JSON documents with metadata
download_mapcc_files: download MAP-CC dataset files from Hugging Face hub to a local output path with progress tracking
open_concatenated_gzip_files: open multiple gzip files as a single concatenated decompressed binary stream for sequential reading
read_jsonl_shards: read JSONL file shards from a data folder and yield Documents with configurable skip, limit, and glob pattern
